name: Card
purpose: Hold one record or one idea in a surface that can stand on its own.
description: A small surface with a status badge, a title, supporting copy, and one action.

mark.description: Syntari icon shown in the card's leading mark, so the card says what kind of thing it holds. The registry index lists every name as icons.

open.description: The person asked to open the item. Omit action to show no button.

props.title: Q3 board pack
props.body: Revenue, retention, and hiring updates for the October meeting.

guidance.summary: Holds one object a person can read, open, or act on alone, among peers they choose between.
useWhen: Each item is an independent object, such as a document or a project, that people open or act on one at a time.
Items are browsed as peers, and each needs a title, a short description, and one action.

avoidWhen.text: Items of the same kind are scanned or compared: rows group them without a box each.
One record's attributes: label and value pairs say it in less space.
Pending work with owners and due dates.
A single fact or figure: a box adds a boundary around one word.

states.label: Default
states.description: A surface with a mark, a title, an optional badge and body, and one optional action.

dos.title: One action per card
dos.description: The card is the object; a second button splits what clicking means.

dos.title: A title that names the object
dos.description: People choose between cards by their titles.

donts.title: Cards as grouping
donts.description: A box per fact repeats borders and labels; a list groups them.

donts.title: Cards inside panels
donts.description: Two boundaries around one item read as clutter, not structure.

donts.title: A card per task in a queue
donts.description: Equal boxes hide which task is most urgent.

content: Titles are noun phrases, under six words.
The body is one sentence; detail belongs to what the card opens.

notes: The card is a group named by its title.
Its action names the object, such as Open pack, not just Open.

composition.defaultVisible: Title, badge, one sentence, and the action.
composition.density: In a dense screen, cards become rows of a table or list; a grid of cards wastes the space between boxes.
composition.contentLength: A title under 60 characters and a body under 120.

redundantWith.reason: A card per attribute repeats what one list says.
A card around a figure duplicates the stat card's own surface.

mistakes: Three or more cards each holding one fact.
A card inside a panel or another card.
Every card with its own button, so no action leads.
composition.responsive: Cards wrap to one column; keep each card's action reachable without horizontal scrolling.
